t: The Collingwood DT4 fixed fire rated LED downlight provides efficient and safe illumination for various indoor settings. This integrated LED fitting offers a warm white 3000K light with 460 lumens, replicating the appearance of traditional halogen lighting. It is ideal for both domestic and commercial installations, including bathrooms and kitchens, thanks to its IP65 rating. The downlight features a durable steel body with a matt white bezel and is fire rated for 30, 60, and 90 minutes, ensuring safety. With a 40,000-hour lifespan and a 55° beam angle, it delivers reliable and consistent lighting. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Includes Bezel & Fast Fix Terminal Connector
